name: FIR-Bench-Multi-Docs-FinQA
description: FIR-Bench-Multi-Docs-FinQA is a multi-document financial question-answering benchmark that tests models' ability to retrieve and reason over multiple financial documents to produce numeric and explanatory answers. It emphasizes multi-step numerical reasoning grounded in financial reports and tables across several documents. The benchmark is intended to evaluate document retrieval, multi-hop reasoning, and precise numeric answer generation in finance-specific contexts.
evaluation_method: exact_match (numeric/exact-answer match; may include program/execution-based validation where applicable)
reputation: A niche, specialized dataset for financial multi-document QA used in targeted research on financial reasoning and document grounding rather than broad mainstream benchmarks.
